answer: In an agent marketplace trading timber, vine cuttings and lantern parts, each seller identity must lock a bond before receiving an order quota. The ledger prevents the same funds from backing multiple identities, and withdrawal requires a 30-day wait. Creating 1,000 eligible identities therefore requires 1,000 separate bonds: generating names is free, but scaling a sybil swarm ties up real capital and imposes financing costs throughout the lockup.
